slides.title: Mental Health
slides.body:
Every programme at Kusnacht Practice rests on three connected medical pillars. Together, they address the full picture of a person's health and wellbeing.

Mental health is personal, so our care is too. We pair world-leading clinical expertise with a collaborative approach that centres your needs and goals.

Psychiatrists and psychotherapists partner with you to design bespoke treatment plans that foster stability, clarity, and long-term renewal.

slides.title: What do we treat?
slides.body:
We treat a wide range of psychological and emotional conditions:

- Addiction
- Alcoholism
- Depression
- Burnout
- Trauma
- Anxiety Disorder
- Perinatal Mental Health & Wellbeing
